description:
The best GTA 6 moments from the Nov 19 streams: Kai Cenat, Asmongold, CaseOh, TheBurntPeanut, xQc and more. A new compilation every day.

0:00 xQc was just driving over the bridge
0:13 CaseOh promised not to crash it this time
0:56 Stable Ronaldo's one excuse when the cops showed up
1:15 Jynxzi said don't even worry about it while flying low
1:26 Asmongold tries to ride a horse like it's Red Dead
1:52 TheBurntPeanut's aura bar was almost full
2:13 Asmongold takes a semi truck straight down a hill
2:26 xQc said watch this and hit the stunt jump with a passenger
2:45 TheBurntPeanut opens the wrong car door
3:19 Kai Cenat took the quick way down from the roof
3:40 Syndicate stepped away from his desk mid-drive
3:53 Stable Ronaldo plows through a GTA 6 bus stop and can't stop apologizing
4:03 xQc tried a bike wheelie
4:17 VanossGaming - Vanoss crew chased a stranger with a dead seagull
4:43 Asmongold let Jesus take the wheel on a quad bike

Streamers in this video:
xQc: twitch.tv/xqc
CaseOh: twitch.tv/caseoh_
Stable Ronaldo: twitch.tv/stableronaldo
Jynxzi: twitch.tv/jynxzi
Asmongold: twitch.tv/zackrawrr
TheBurntPeanut: twitch.tv/theburntpeanut
Kai Cenat: twitch.tv/kaicenat
Syndicate: twitch.tv/syndicate
VanossGaming: twitch.tv/vanosscrew

#gta6 #gtavi #gta6clips #kaicenat #asmongold #caseoh #theburntpeanut #xqc #jynxzi
